A statistically ranked "most enriched GO biological process" cannot be asserted for this capsule: the GO over-representation test could not be executed because no GO ontology/annotation resource exists anywhere in the environment (final sweep confirmed: 3 Python interpreters — venv 3.12 with 24 packages, uv CPython 3.12.14 with no site-packages, system Python 3.14 with 250 system/desktop packages — none contain GO tools or data; no R infrastructure; no proxy/mirror settings and no network access; no provisioning hooks in the workspace; no bundled GO/gene-set files on the filesystem). No GO gene sets were fabricated.

What was executed and validated (analysis_asxl1_de.py, outputs in output/): raw featureCounts matrix (60,662 Ensembl genes; 2 samples without metadata dropped), 7 disease vs 7 control fibroblast samples, prefilter (>=10 counts in >=7 samples) keeping 17,883 genes, DESeq2-style negative-binomial GLM with design ~ condition + sex (sex included because it is imbalanced: disease 6F/1M vs control 4F/3M), median-of-ratios size factors, Cox-Reid-adjusted dispersion MLE with trend shrinkage, Wald test with BH correction. Result: 416 differentially expressed genes at BH FDR<0.05 (314 up, 102 down in disease); the up-regulated genes are prominently extracellular-matrix and developmental genes (e.g., FBN2, COMP, IGF2, IGFBP2, CNTN4, CAPN6, VANGL2, PIEZO2) and the down-regulated set includes PSG4, STMN2, STEAP4, CCN5 — a descriptive observation of the DE gene list, not a computed GO enrichment. The model was validated on a simulated negative-control dataset (dispersion unbiased, 96% sensitivity, FDR controlled) and concordant with an independent voom-style analysis (Spearman rho = 0.946).

The over-representation machinery (one-sided Fisher/hypergeometric over the 13,632 expressed protein-coding genes as universe, min gene-set size 10, BH correction, tie-break by fold enrichment) is implemented in the script and will produce output/go_bp_ora.csv — and hence the final ranked answer — as soon as any GO BP annotation file (e.g., an MSigDB C5:BP .gmt or a GO .gaf) is provided; until then, no GO BP term can be honestly named as "most enriched."
